# Model Card — world_model_ttf

**Status**: TRAINED — **LSTM time-to-failure (TTF) forecaster (torch CPU)**. Stage 8 PREDICT step (KB_25 step 1, G-019).
The project's fourth real trained weight.

## Overview
- **Name**: `world_model_ttf` · weights `models/world_model_ttf.pt` · metrics `…metrics.json`.
- **Role**: forecast **minutes-to-failure** for a degrading machine from a short window of its AI4I-unit
  telemetry. This is the timing signal the Stage-7 RL intervention lacked (it knew a machine was at-risk but
  not *when* it would fail). KB_25's own example: *"LSTM predicts M fails in ~8 min."* **Not** a certified
  safety function.
- **Inference**: `backend/ml/world_model.py::WorldModel.predict_ttf(window)`. Honest: raises
  `ModelUnavailableError` if torch/weights absent — never fabricates (the old stub's `np.random.randn`
  fallbacks + untrained-random-weights path were removed). Loaded with `torch.load(weights_only=True)`.
- **Architecture**: 1-layer LSTM (hidden 48) → MLP head → scalar TTF (minutes). Input: window of 6 telemetry
  samples × 5 features `(air_temp_k, process_temp_k, rot_speed_rpm, torque_nm, tool_wear_min)`, standardised
  with train-only mean/std (stored in the checkpoint).

## Training
- **Data**: seeded SimWorld crack rollouts (`backend/training/stage_08_world_model/rollouts.py`). 40 train seeds
  × 4 stages → 3,251 windows; 12 disjoint val seeds → 852 windows. **No external dataset.** Label = ground-truth
  remaining-time-to-failure from the sim's own crack schedule (no fabrication).
- **Honest task design**: crack ETA is RANDOMISED (8–20 min), so a single telemetry snapshot under-determines
  absolute TTF (telemetry reflects crack *proximity*, not absolute time). The model succeeds by reading the
  degradation *rate* across the 6-sample window (which reveals the ETA), so it forecasts absolute TTF — a
  legitimate temporal-inference task, not leakage.
- **Reproduce**: `python training/stage_08_world_model/train.py --config training/stage_08_world_model/config.yaml`
  (seed 8; ~36 s CPU; 60 epochs).

## Evaluation (MEASURED 2026-06-13)
| Metric | Value | Baseline | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| TTF MAE (held-out val, minutes) | **0.067** | naive mean-TTF **2.979** | **+97.8%** vs baseline; TTF range 0.3–16.0 min |
| TTF MAE (fresh seeds 60–64, minutes) | **0.070** | naive **3.230** | **+97.8%**; disjoint seeds → not seed-specific (`training/evals/stage08/`) |

Genuine measurable win (unlike a near-trivial decision problem): the learned model beats the naive baseline by
~98% on held-out AND fresh seeds. The "no metric without a baseline" rule is honoured.

## Limitations & honest scope
- **Proxy/sim only (G-035)**: synthetic SimWorld telemetry; physics-motivated AI4I-unit mapping. Re-fit on real
  plant telemetry before any production claim.
- Forecasts TTF for the **machine-crack** degradation mode only (the scenario the slice targets).
- The very low MAE reflects a clean, low-noise simulator; real telemetry will be noisier — do not market the
  0.067-min figure as a real-world number.
- Not wired to any actuator; the Stage-17 functional-safety wrapper must precede any real-world use.

## Companion: causal attribution v1 (G-020 partial, Stage 8)
`services/diagnosis.py::attribute_cause` adds a counterfactual root-cause classification (machine-local vs
externally-influenced) via a do-operator over the **known** SimWorld structural causal model. **Honest boundary:**
this is a counterfactual over a documented structure — NOT learned causal discovery, and NOT neuro-symbolic
VERIFICATION (KB_25 step 3). Those remain PLANNED (G-020 → Stage 17 / a research spike).
